messages:
rachel (ml): heads-up: onboarding kommando-30b-qat-int4 proposer today. goal: measure speculative proposer speed vs fp16 verifier and check schema/regression risk.

diego (bench): what's the eval set?

rachel (ml): 1k prod-sampled prompts + 500 strict-schema tests + 500 code snippets.

yuna (runtime): runtime note: int4 proposer uses asymmetric quant; we see rank shifts vs fp16 in top-5 occasionally.

diego (bench): quick run (bs4, 20 runs) on a100:
- fp16 p50=90ms/token
- int4 proposer p50=52ms/token -> ~1.73x speedup
quality quick-check (redwood-eval): fp16=100, int4=99.1 (-0.9)
schema breaks: 4/1000 (mostly missing fields)

rachel (ml): -0.9% ok-ish but schema breaks are concerning. mitigations: 1) format-aware routing (structured->no early stream), 2) softmax-smoothing on proposer, 3) proposer-logit-scale in runtime + confidence threshold fallback.

yuna (runtime): can add --proposer-logit-scale and --proposer-smoothing flags. will emit "proposer_agreement" telemetry. estimate PRs in next 4h.

ops-bot: routing override ready: rule id r-int4-7165. apply?

rachel (ml): apply. also diego: run 5k sweep with/without smoothing and post artifacts.

diego (bench): started. commands used:
redwood-sim --proposer kommando-30b-int4 --verifier kommando-30b-fp16 --prompts 5000 --metrics redwood-eval, schema_breaks, proposer_agreement

diego (bench): artifacts will be at s3://redwood-qa/int4-onboard/7165432100/summary.json when done. ETA ~5h.

yuna (runtime): when sweep done we'll enable proposer flags on canary and monitor agreement + fallback rate.

rachel (ml): acceptance: delta <= -0.7% and schema breaks <=1/10k. if green we'll roll to 10% speculative.

ops-bot: routing override applied to cluster redwood-canary-4, rule r-int4-7165.

diego (bench): posted interim: smoothing reduced schema breaks 4->1 in the 1k schema slice, redwood-eval delta improved to -0.4. latency penalty ~+3ms/token.

rachel (ml): promising. keep thread open for full sweep results.
